name: Article 1, before § 1 – 17
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1232 as regards the extension of its period of application
part_text: -1 In Regulation (EU) 2021/1232, the following Article is inserted: Article 3a Detection technologies deployed under this Regulation shall be limited to systems that operate in a content-oblivious manner such as the comparison of digital fingerprints ("hashing"), or function locally on the user's device. Such technologies shall not include systematic scanning or filtering of text-based communications.
